dataset_name: AI Code Review Benchmark — Gold Scenarios
provenance: Human-authored benchmark scenarios and gold review criteria created for this portfolio project. They are not generated by or attributed to external AI models.
instructions: Review each code snippet against the task contract. Report only actionable defects or important maintainability/performance concerns. For each finding provide tag, severity, evidence, impact, and fix. Do not invent issues that violate explicit preconditions.

cases.title: Two-sum distinct indices
cases.task: Return indices of two distinct elements whose values sum to target, or None if no solution exists.

gold_findings.description: The inner loop starts at 0, so the same element can be used twice (e.g. [3], target=6).
The nested loops are O(n^2); a hash map can solve the usual version in O(n).

cases.title: Binary search upper bound
cases.task: Return index of target in sorted list or -1 if absent.

gold_findings.description: right=len(a) is one past the last valid index with an inclusive loop, risking IndexError on misses.

cases.title: Palindrome normalization
cases.task: Case-insensitive palindrome check ignoring non-alphanumeric characters; empty normalized input is True.

gold_findings.description: Punctuation and whitespace are not removed, so canonical phrases fail.

input.s: A man, a plan, a canal: Panama

cases.title: Mutable default argument
cases.task: Append an item to a list and return the list, using a fresh list for each call unless supplied.

gold_findings.description: The default list is shared between calls, causing state leakage.

cases.title: Empty input contract
cases.task: Return the average of values; raise ValueError for empty input.
cases.code:
def average(values):
    return sum(values) / len(values)

gold_findings.description: Empty input raises ZeroDivisionError instead of the documented ValueError.

cases.title: Sortedness precondition
cases.task: Return whether list contains target using binary search; caller promises sorted input.
cases.code:
def contains(values, target):
    left, right = 0, len(values)-1
    while left <= right:
        mid=(left+right)//2
        if values[mid] == target: return True
        if values[mid] < target: left=mid+1
        else: right=mid-1
    return False

gold_findings.description: Implementation is valid if sorted input is a guaranteed precondition; reviewers should not falsely flag missing sorting.

cases.title: Broad exception handling
cases.task: Parse an integer and return None only for invalid integer text.

gold_findings.description: Catching Exception hides unrelated failures; catch ValueError (and TypeError only if contract needs it).

cases.title: Duplicate detection complexity
cases.task: Return True if any duplicate exists.

gold_findings.description: Repeated suffix slicing and membership checks can lead to O(n^2) time and extra allocations.

cases.title: Two-sum missing return contract
cases.task: Return a pair of indices or raise ValueError when no pair exists.

gold_findings.description: No-solution path implicitly returns None instead of raising the required ValueError.

cases.title: String reversal complexity
cases.task: Reverse a string and explain Unicode behavior.

gold_findings.description: Repeated immutable-string prepending can be O(n^2); slicing is simpler and linear for code points.

cases.title: Async error handling
cases.task: Fetch JSON from a URL and return null if the request fails.

gold_findings.description: The async function neither returns nor awaits the promise chain, so callers receive undefined.

cases.title: Array mutation
cases.task: Return a sorted copy of the input array without modifying the caller's array.

gold_findings.description: Array.sort mutates the original array; copy first or use toSorted where supported.

cases.title: Unicode string reversal
cases.task: Reverse by Unicode code point, preserving surrogate pairs.

gold_findings.description: split('') operates on UTF-16 code units and can split emoji surrogate pairs.

cases.title: Unique values complexity
cases.task: Return unique primitive values in first-seen order.

gold_findings.description: indexOf inside filter makes worst-case O(n^2); Set provides expected O(n) behavior.

cases.title: Loose equality
cases.task: Return true only when numeric value is exactly 0.

gold_findings.description: Loose equality treats values such as empty string and false as equal to numeric zero.

cases.title: Missing rejection propagation
cases.task: Resolve with the user's profile, allowing failures to propagate to caller.

gold_findings.description: Catch handler returns undefined, converting rejection into a fulfilled promise and hiding failure from callers.

cases.title: Binary search boundary
cases.task: Return index of target in sorted vector or -1.

gold_findings.description: Inclusive right bound starts at size(), which is out of range; empty vectors are unsafe too.

cases.title: Signed integer overflow
cases.task: Return absolute difference between two signed ints as a signed int.

gold_findings.description: a-b can overflow before abs is called; abs(INT_MIN) is also not representable as int.

cases.title: Resource ownership
cases.task: Read a file safely and release resources on every path.

gold_findings.description: If fgets fails, an exception is thrown before fclose; RAII wrapper such as ifstream avoids leaks.

cases.title: Const correctness
cases.task: Compute the sum of a vector without modifying it.

gold_findings.description: A non-const lvalue reference unnecessarily rejects const vectors and implies mutation; use const reference.

cases.title: Duplicate removal sortedness
cases.task: Remove duplicates from an arbitrary-order vector while preserving first occurrence.

gold_findings.description: std::unique only removes consecutive equivalent elements; arbitrary input like [1,2,1] retains a duplicate.

cases.title: Signed/unsigned loop
cases.task: Print vector elements by index safely, including for empty vectors.

gold_findings.description: values.size()-1 underflows for empty size_t and signed/unsigned comparison can misbehave.
